import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import {createProgression,PROGRESS_KEY,readGodMode,saveGodMode} from '../dist/progression.js';
const storage=(values={})=>({values:{...values},getItem(k){return this.values[k]??null},setItem(k,v){this.values[k]=v}});
test('3D palace requires both previous completions in either order and persists',()=>{for(const order of [[0,1],[1,0]]){const store=storage(),p=createProgression(store);assert.equal(p.canEnter(2),false);assert.equal(p.complete(2),false);p.complete(order[0]);assert.equal(p.canEnter(2),false);p.complete(order[1]);assert.equal(p.canEnter(2),true);assert.equal(p.complete(2),true);assert.deepEqual(createProgression(store).snapshot().completed,[true,true,true])}});
test('legacy 3D completion times migrate; invalid and 2D records never unlock',()=>{for(const bad of ['0','-1','Infinity','NaN','null','','true','{}']){assert.equal(createProgression(storage({'mosslight-best-0':bad,'mosslight-best-1':'42'})).canEnter(2),false)}assert.equal(createProgression(storage({'mosslight-best-0':'12.5','mosslight-best-1':'32'})).canEnter(2),true);assert.equal(createProgression(storage({'mosslight-pixel-progress':'{"version":1,"completed":[true,true,true]}'})).canEnter(2),false)});
test('corrupt, unavailable and unusual storage remain safe',()=>{for(const value of ['{','null','[]','true','{"version":1,"completed":[1,"true",true]}'])assert.equal(createProgression(storage({[PROGRESS_KEY]:value})).canEnter(2),false);const store={getItem(){throw Error('denied')},setItem(){throw Error('denied')}};const p=createProgression(store);p.complete(0);p.complete(1);assert.equal(p.canEnter(2),true);for(const level of [-1,3,2.1,NaN,'2',null])assert.equal(p.canEnter(level),false)});
test('god toggle persists independently and never grants completion',()=>{const store=storage(),p=createProgression(store);assert.equal(readGodMode(store),false);saveGodMode(store,true);assert.equal(readGodMode(store),true);assert.deepEqual(p.snapshot().completed,[false,false,false]);assert.equal(createProgression(store).canEnter(2),false);saveGodMode(store,false);assert.equal(readGodMode(store),false)});
